import pytest
from your_module import binary_search  # Replace with actual module name

# Happy Path Tests
class TestBinarySearchHappyPath:
    def test_target_found_in_middle(self):
        arr = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
        assert binary_search(arr, 3) == 2

    def test_target_found_at_start(self):
        arr = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
        assert binary_search(arr, 1) == 0

    def test_target_found_at_end(self):
        arr = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
        assert binary_search(arr, 5) == 4

    def test_target_not_present(self):
        arr = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
        assert binary_search(arr, 6) == -1

    def test_single_element_found(self):
        arr = [42]
        assert binary_search(arr, 42) == 0

    def test_single_element_not_found(self):
        arr = [42]
        assert binary_search(arr, 7) == -1

    def test_two_elements_found_first(self):
        arr = [10, 20]
        assert binary_search(arr, 10) == 0

    def test_two_elements_found_second(self):
        arr = [10, 20]
        assert binary_search(arr, 20) == 1

    def test_two_elements_not_found(self):
        arr = [10, 20]
        assert binary_search(arr, 15) == -1

    def test_negative_numbers(self):
        arr = [-5, -3, 0, 2, 4]
        assert binary_search(arr, -3) == 1
        assert binary_search(arr, -5) == 0
        assert binary_search(arr, -1) == -1

    def test_duplicates(self):
        arr = [1, 2, 2, 2, 3]
        # Should return one of the valid indices for 2
        index = binary_search(arr, 2)
        assert index in [1, 2, 3]

    def test_large_list(self):
        arr = list(range(10000))
        assert binary_search(arr, 9999) == 9999
        assert binary_search(arr, 5000) == 5000
        assert binary_search(arr, 10000) == -1
